title: Ladies Day 2024
subtitle: A season of Southwest Division Ladies Days, club by club, through 2024.

sections.heading: April 2024 — Newport Harbor LBC
body: Our first Ladies Day of 2024 was held at the Newport Harbor LBC. A big thank you to Newport Harbor’s hospitality committee for serving a wonderful selection for breakfast and delicious items for lunch. Everyone complimented the wonderful food. The day couldn’t have been more perfect with beautiful weather along with great lady bowlers. 36 Ladies attended and the clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC, and Santa Ana LBC.
We welcomed five ladies attending Ladies Day for the first time: Barbara Parry, Mary Sanchez, Sharon Barrington, Melody Lewis and Tracy Simons. I love to see our group expanding 😊
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Shelley Cohen Eleanor Reafsnyder Barbara Parry
2nd Place: Irene Myrwold Carol Kangas Sharon Barrington
3rd Place: Sandra Mirenesco Tory Ruppert Tracy Simons
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Sandra Mirenesco Charlyn Moltane Kathy Yazarski
2nd Place: Trish Soto Patty Doidge Molly Smulian
3rd Place: Joan Narmontas Peggy Torrance
Congratulations to all the winners.
Our next Ladies Day will be May 15th at Long Beach LBC. Please check the signup sheets posted at your club.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: May 2024 — Long Beach LBC
body: Thank you to Long Beach LBC for hosting this Ladies Day. Their Hospitality committee served a wonderful selection for breakfast and delicious salads for lunch. The weather was perfect, not too hot and not too cold. There were 46 Ladies attending and the clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa Monica LBC and Santa Ana LBC.

We welcomed three ladies attending Ladies Day for the first time: Callie Roth from Laguna Woods, Cindy Chafe from Hermosa Beach LBC and Annette Kasperski from Santa Monica LBC. Hope to see you again soon.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place tie: Ann Maier Trish Goldin Aileen Broccardo
1st Place tie: Holly Gross Cindy Chafe Jeri DeCastro
2nd Place: June “Kiwi” Ralph Tory Rupert Annette Kasperski
3rd Place tie: Peg Anderson Manya Urane Peggy Torrance
3rd Place tie: Doreen Hall Patti Doidge Debra Wong
Cut throat winner: Norma Goodhart
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Ann Maier Cindy Jones Linda Bator
2nd Place: Charlyn Moltane Jeri DeCarlo Callie Roth
3rd Place: Doreen Hall Cindy Pham Barbara Wallace
Congratulations to all the winners.
Our next Ladies Day will be June 12th at Oaks North LBC. They will be serving lunch so no one will need to bring their own 😊 Please check the signup sheets posted at your club.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: August 14, 2024 — Laguna Beach LBC
body: Ladies Day is always so much fun. Laguna Beach hosted our August ladies day and what beautiful hospitality they provided. There was a great assortment of breakfast goodies and then plenty of salads and lunch items. Let’s not forget Heather’s heavenly hash for dessert. Everyone attending is always amazed at the beautiful surroundings and the ocean views as they bowl their games.

We had another terrific turnout with 52 ladies from 11 different SW Division clubs. Everything ran smoothly and we all had a fun day bowling. The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC, Pasadena LBC, Santa Ana LBC and The Groves LBC.

The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time and we hope to continue seeing them: Tami Dorsey, JoAnn Lewy, Diane Windsor, Molly Welch (all from Pasadena LBC), Elena Kraus from Newport Harbor LBC and Jill Pilcher from Laguna Beach LBC.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Linda Pretzel Roberts Cindy Jones Molly Smulian
2nd Place: Heather Stewart Maureen Farris Kathy Becker
3rd Place: Carol Dayn Keetje Berndt Phyllis Mitchell
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Heather Stewart Aileen Broccardo Sharon Barrington
2nd Place: Doreen Hall Monica Kropf Molly Smulian
3rd Place: Susan Mott Charlyn Moltane Diane Winston
Congratulations to all the winners.
I hope we can keep the momentum going and have the same turnout at our next Ladies Day – September 11th at The Groves
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: October 9, 2024 — Santa Monica LBC
body: Santa Monica LBC recently hosted a memorable Ladies Day, with 36 participants in attendance. The event kicked off with an impressive array of sweets, lovingly prepared by members who put great effort into creating delicious homemade treats. Lunch featured a selection of salads, fruit, and other goodies, all of which reflected the generous hospitality of the club.
This Ladies Day was dedicated to the memory of Ann Meir, a beloved member of Santa Monica LBC, who is deeply missed. A moment of silence was shared in her honor.

Ladies from nine Southwest Division clubs participated: Beverly Hills, Casta Del Sol, Hermosa Beach, Holmby, Laguna Beach, Long Beach, Newport Beach, Santa Ana, and Santa Monica. We were thrilled to welcome several first-time participants: Ariyah Cohen, Gina Moffitt, Amy Wong, Frances Olsen, Nancy Kearsley, and Sue Price. We hope to see them at many future events.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Gina Fitten Linda Daly Gina Moffitt
2nd Place: Charlyn Moltane Ariyah Cohen Sally Chateau
3rd Place: Trish Soto June “Kiwi” Ralph
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Charlyn Moltane Ariyah Cohen Dell Arambula
2nd Place: Trish Soto Sally Chateau
3rd Place: Sandra Mironesco Cindy Jones Maureen Schulte
Congratulations to all the winners.
Next month Casta Del Sol LBC will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, November 13th. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: November 13, 2024 — Casta del Sol LBC
body: A big thank you to Casta del Sol for hosting Ladies Day. We had spectacular hospitality starting with a wonderful breakfast selection followed by great salads, fruit and desserts for lunch. The Casta del Sol ladies made the desserts extra special as they were homemade. What a delicious treat for everyone. We had a great turnout once again with 30 Ladies from the following clubs: Casta del Sol LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC and Oaks North LBC. Thanks to all these clubs participating and making this such a fun day.
We had three ladies join us for the first time at Ladies Day: Jana Elder from Laguna Beach LBC and Joy Brown and Anne Philips from Laguna Woods. I hope to see them at future Ladies Day.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Irene Myrwold Eleanor Reafsnyder Jana Edler
2nd Place: Cynthia Nolan Sharon Barrington Madeline Wilson
Cut throat Winner: Shelley Cohen
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st/2nd Place tie: Diana Wenzel Phyllis Mitchell Patty Doidge
1st/2nd Place tie: Lisa Milligan Amy White
3rd Place: Cynthia Nolan Deborah Long
Congratulations to all the winners.

Our next Ladies Day will be the Holiday Luncheon at Laguna Woods LBC on Wednesday, December 4th at Laguna Woods. 1 game of bowling in the morning and the luncheon in Clubhouse #7 across the street from the lawn bowling greens. This is a really fun way to end our year. Everyone remember to bring a wrapped gift for the raffle prizes.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: December 4, 2024 — Holiday Luncheon, Laguna Woods LBC
body: What a fabulous year of Ladies Day games. In 2024 we had 143 ladies participate from various clubs in the SouthWest Division. We just had our last event of the year with a very successful attendance of 64 ladies. A huge thank you to Laguna Woods LBC for hosting this event and having a wonderful assortment for breakfast.
We bowled one game since we were all eager to go straight to the luncheon after this game. Here are the winners of that game:
1st Place: Heather Stewart Beverly Ponder Amy Ding
2nd Place: Doreen Hall Dorothy Pinella Ginny Barrett
3rd Place: Linda Roberts Barbara Clark Kathi Becker
Congratulations to all the winners.

Our luncheon was so much fun with everyone decked out in their holiday attire wearing fun outfits and hats. It was a very lively crowd with lots of laughter. Our buffet lunch was delicious and everyone was very happy with the caterer this year. Our raffle prize table was filled with beautifully wrapped gifts to choose from. The holiday spirit filled the room – thank you to all who attended.
We are blessed to have Heather Stewart donate a handmade quilted holiday table runner for a special raffle. The winner this year of this was Doreen Hall – Congratulations.

Goodbye to 2024 Ladies Day and we wish everyone a very Merry Christmas, Happy Hanukkah and HAPPY NEW YEAR. See you in 2025 when we have our first ladies day in March. As soon as all the clubs send in their requested dates to host, you will receive the 2025 schedule.
Shelley Cohen
Diana Wenzel
Joan Narmontas
Holiday Luncheon committee

migrationNotes: Migrated from the Squarespace blog collection /ladies-day-2024, which held six posts — one per Ladies Day. Each post became a prose section (its date and venue as the heading) followed by its gallery.

Every post's URL slug is still a Squarespace placeholder ('blog-post-title-one-s9ml8…'), but the post titles themselves were real, so the headings come from those titles. The slugs are not carried across; the page is now addressed as /ladies-day-2024.

The April and May posts give no day of the month in their titles. The April post says the next Ladies Day would be 'May 15th at Long Beach LBC', so the May event was almost certainly 15 May 2024 — but the source never states either date outright, so the headings say only 'April 2024' and 'May 2024'.

There is no post for September 2024, although the August post says the next Ladies Day would be 'September 11th at The Groves'. Nothing was lost in migration — the post does not exist on the source site.
The April 2024 post has no photographs of its own, so it appears as text alone.
The August 2024 post has only one image, a photo collage assembled by the club; the individual photographs behind it are not available separately.
Squarespace's own alt text on these images was just the file name ('IMG_3963.jpg'), so all alt text here was written fresh from the pictures.
